=== TABLE HEADER (the column definitions of this census table, printed once at the start of the section; use to name the columns) ===

CENSUS RETURN.
CENSUS RETURN of Resident and Nomadic Indians; Denominations to which they belong, with approximate number
belonging to each Denomination, as well as the number of Pagans in the Dominion of Canada, by Provinces.
